supersedes.reason: STALE: v0.1 carried merkle root 78d4e019... of the retired 167-card root. A prepared transaction must name the CURRENT root's digest or it anchors history by accident.

subject.anchor_datum_note: sha256(root.json) is the canonical datum across ALL witnesses — OTS subject, Rekor content and sidecar artifact.sha256 are this same value, so every chain attests one identical subject.

schema_registry.note: Registry fee on this predeploy is read at execution time (eth_call) — NOT assumed zero.

transactions_prepared.schema_string: bytes32 rootSha256 bytes32 merkleRoot uint64 cardCount

transactions_prepared.function: attest((address recipient,uint64 expirationTime,bool revocable,bytes32 refUID,bytes data))
transactions_prepared.encoding_note: data = SchemaEncoder('bytes32,bytes32,uint64').encodeData([...]) via the official EAS SDK or ethers AbiCoder — do not hand-roll

cost.schema_registry_fee: UNKNOWN — read on-chain at execution time; if > $0.05 stop and escalate to owner
cost.funding_source: OWNER BASE WALLET — owner-gated, NOT executed by this lane

replay_verification.principle: After submission ANY third party reads the attestation back from a public RPC and byte-compares it to the published root — no CSOAI tooling, no permission.
steps: 1. Take attestation UID from the attest() receipt (Attested event topic[1])
2. eth_call 0x4200...0021 getAttestation(bytes32 uid) → {schema, data, attester, time, revocable}
3. Decode data with SchemaEncoder('bytes32,bytes32,uint64'); assert rootSha256 == f1913ecaae4ea18ac113d341c1b050318cec4c49dcda440dacbbadb89eca1b4e
4. Independently fetch https://councilof.ai/root.json, sha256 the bytes, assert equality with the attested rootSha256
6. Record tx hash + UID + block in interop/root-witness-latest.json witnesses.eas_base (ATTESTED, replacing NOT_YET)

owner_action_needed: 1. Fund a Base wallet (≤ $0.05 ETH covers both txs at observed gas)
2. Read the schema-registry fee at execution time; stop if > $0.05
5. Record tx hash + attestation UID in the witness sidecar

x402_integration.note: The x402 rail already lives on Base (eip155:8453); same chain as the payment rail.
